texts: Every sky-cat has broad feathered wings.
Keepers rarely witness a sky-cat hunt.

fields.sentence: Every sky-cat has broad feathered wings.
parse: (: sky_cat_wing_rule (Implication (Member $x sky_cat) (And (Member (sk_have $x) have) (Holder (sk_have $x) $x) (Theme (sk_have $x) (sk_wings $x)) (Member (sk_wings $x) wing) (Member (sk_wings $x) broad) (Member (sk_wings $x) feathered))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The plural object 'wings' is typed as a single individual — (Member (sk_wings $x) wing) — instead of the group form (GroupOf (sk_wings $x) wing) the plural rules require, so the plurality is lost and the symbol is asserted to BE one wing.

The descriptive modifiers 'broad' and 'feathered' are predicated of the plural's own symbol with Member, which is the group-as-object reading the plural rules explicitly bar; a descriptive modifier on a plural must distribute over the members, not ride the plural symbol.

q2_gaps: A descriptive modifier on a plural object that lives INSIDE a rule conclusion: the per-member distribution rule is defined only over a top-level group's (PartOf $x <group>) domain, and the instruction set never shows or licenses nesting such an Implication inside an already-quantified conclusion whose group is a Skolem function of the rule variable.
review.notes: The routing decisions are right — the explicit universal 'every' correctly blocks the bare-kind relational-generic route in favor of a distributing rule at 1.0/0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, 'has' takes Holder/Theme, and the compound sky_cat emits its head genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed. Only the encoding of the plural object is defective.

issues.reason: The doctrine's own precedent for a plural object under a universal is a per-binding Skolem GROUP - (GroupOf (sk_books $x) book) in "every student read three books" - and Coordination & plurals bars a group symbol from a class slot ("a group is an individual; it never goes in a class slot"), so (Member (sk_wings $x) wing) is ill-typed and asserts the plurality is one wing.

Categorical statements states flatly that a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol - "(Member sk_group_1 wooden) says the group-as-object is wooden" - and Compound concepts routes a DESCRIPTIVE modifier on a plural (as broad/feathered are, not classifiers) through the distributive rule, so both modifier atoms assert of the collection what the text asserts of each wing.

gaps_confirmed: A descriptive modifier on a plural object living INSIDE a rule conclusion: the per-member distribution rule is defined only over a top-level group's (PartOf $x <group>) domain, and no nesting of such an Implication inside an already-quantified conclusion whose group is a Skolem function of the rule variable is shown or licensed.
new_gaps: "Every N has ADJ PLURALs" is doubly unlicensed at the modifier: the fusing-classifier slot in the group's kind position is barred (broad/feathered are descriptive, not classifying), and the distributive route would need a nested rule whose own variable ranges over a Skolem-function group - against the constraint that variables must not co-vary inside one stored term - so no compliant form exists for this construction.
adjudication.defect_summary: The plural object's typing has a compliant form - (GroupOf (sk_wings $x) wing) in place of (Member (sk_wings $x) wing) - but the modifiers do NOT: broad and feathered must distribute to the members, and the instruction set licenses no per-member distribution rule nested inside a rule conclusion over a Skolem-function group, so this sentence currently has no licensed complete parse (filed as a gap).
adjudication.notes: The routing is otherwise right: the explicit universal correctly blocks the bare-kind relational-generic route in favour of a 1.0/0.9 distributing rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion, "has" takes Holder/Theme, and sky_cat emits its head genus with the noun modifier unexposed.

fields.sentence: Keepers rarely witness a sky-cat hunt.

q1_issues.issue: The compound noun 'a sky-cat hunt' is unpacked into a hunt event carrying (Patient (sk_hunt $x) sky_cat), which asserts that the sky-cat is what is hunted — a role relation the compound never states, and one that also picks one of two readings (hunt by vs. hunt of sky-cats); the compound-kind route (one fused symbol plus its head genus, noun modifier never exposed) is what the instruction set licenses.

The subject of 'witness' is given Experiencer (with the object as Stimulus), but the progressive test that bounds the stative psych/perception class admits 'is witnessing', which groups the verb with notice/observe and makes its subject an ordinary Agent.

q2_gaps: noun-noun compound whose head is an event/deverbal noun with an incorporated participant ('a sky-cat hunt', 'a bird count') — the compound rules bar exposing a noun modifier and give no way to record which role the modifier plays in the denoted eventuality
review.notes: The generic routing is right otherwise: bare-plural habitual to a distributing rule at strength 0.1 for 'rarely', the QuantifierPhrase companion, and (Inheritance sky_cat cat) with the noun modifier unexposed.

issues.reason: Compound concepts fuses 'sky-cat hunt' into one kind emitting only its head genus and states that a noun modifier is never exposed, so (Patient (sk_hunt $x) sky_cat) asserts a participant relation no word puts there - it fails Core patterns' 'point at the words' test and silently picks the hunt-of-sky-cats reading over the hunt-by-sky-cats one.

Thematic roles bounds the Experiencer class by the progressive test rather than by a list, and 'is witnessing' is fine, so witness is an event verb grouped with notice / observe / watch whose subject is an ordinary Agent, not a stative Experiencer.

gaps_confirmed: Noun-noun compound whose head is an event / deverbal noun with an incorporated participant ('a sky-cat hunt', 'a bird count'): the compound rules bar exposing the noun modifier and give no way to record which role the modifier plays in the denoted eventuality.
new_gaps: The role of an EVENT-DENOTING NP object of an agentive perception verb: Stimulus is defined only as a psych state's object or the perceived complement of a perception report (bare infinitive / participle), while the perception-report section says an event is never a Theme acted on - so a plain NP object like 'a sky-cat hunt' under an Agent-subject verb has no specified role slot.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form types the object with the fused compound - (Member (sk_hunt $x) sky_cat_hunt) inside the rule plus top-level (Inheritance sky_cat_hunt hunt) - and emits no role atom for sky_cat at all, since no licensed form records which role a sky-cat plays in the hunt (the confirmed gap); and the subject atom should be (Agent (sk_witness $x) $x) in place of the Experiencer.
adjudication.notes: The generic routing is otherwise correct: bare-plural habitual to a distributing rule, strength 0.1 for 'rarely' with its (QuantifierPhrase keeper witness "rarely") companion, and the sky_cat genus with the noun modifier unexposed. Whether the object role should then be Stimulus or Theme is undetermined and is filed as a new gap, not charged against the parse.
